description: Send keys (a command line or key names) to a tmux pane

keys.description: The command line or key names to send to the pane

pane_target.description: Optional pane target (window.pane) to send the keys to

press_enter.description: Whether to press Enter after sending the keys

session_name.description: The name of the tmux session containing the target pane

name: send_keys
